import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    ans = []
    at_used = False
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        if i + 2 < n and s[i:i+3] == "dot":
            ans.append('.')
            i += 3
        elif i + 1 < n and s[i:i+2] == "at" and not at_used:
            ans.append('@')
            at_used = True
            i += 2
        else:
            ans.append(s[i])
            i += 1
    if ans and ans[-1] == '.':
        ans.pop()
        ans.append("dot")
    print(''.join(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
